en: First Collection (Ekakanipāta), Chapter on the Group of One Hundred and Fifty (Parosatavagga)
“He who would be my refuge when I am touched by suffering—that father of mine acts treacherously toward me in the forest.”
"To whom shall I cry out in the midst of this forest?
He who was my protector now acts with violence.
Thus ends the second Jātaka, the Paṇṇikajātaka.
